reason: The cited evidence shows that SRO exists in high-entropy nanoparticles (E2, E3) and that its origin can be related to electronic structure (E1), but none of the passages provide evidence that SRO can be controlled by cooling rate, that it alleviates strain, raises diffusion barriers, or improves stability at high temperatures. The mechanistic claims are unsupported by the cited literature.
